summary: RoyaLand Co Ltd., a Bermuda-domiciled OTCQB-listed holding company (RLNDF), filed a Form 6-K furnishing an Exhibit 99.1 press release dated September 16, 2026. The release announces a development partnership with NipsApp Game Studios for three free-to-play mobile games—Regalia Cards, Palazzo Chronicles, and Viva Verdi—marketed as Season 1 of the RoyaLand Universe, targeting an October launch on iOS and Android. No financial terms, equity consideration, or transaction structure were disclosed. This is a routine operational/product announcement, not a special situation; no board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics apply. Watch for execution risk and launch timing, not arbitrage.
